subject: Next steps: CarePoint deployment mode & compliance evidence
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Emma Willis <emma.willis@carepointhealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@carepointhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — deployment options & compliance asks

Hi Emma / Liam,

Thanks again for the time today — useful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on the right deployment path for CarePoint.

Summary of requirements you emphasized:
- PHI in scope (patient-identifiable content) — BAA required.
- Internal audit window: annual third-party audit + occasional ad-hoc evidence requests from internal/compliance teams.
- Prefer to keep production data in us-east-1 region.
- Desire to minimize latency to your EHR workflows (latency <120ms preferred for inference calls).

Deployment options we discussed and immediate considerations:
1) Hosted API — fastest to start; Redwood holds model/infra. Good for pilot but you will need a BAA + SOC 2 Type II evidence. We can provide SOC2 artifacts and a BAA; however, some customers with strict audit controls require Dedicated or VPC for stronger isolation.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pool in our environment (single-tenant lane). Predictable throughput and easier to meet audit controls; provisioning lead time ~3–4 weeks after contract sign.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — full customer network isolation, required by some regulated apps. Longer lead time (4–8 weeks depending on networking and on-prem constraints) and usually requires coordination with your network/security teams.

Immediate asks from CarePoint (what you asked us to deliver):
- Copy of Redwood SOC 2 Type II summary and scope (high level) — for your security team to review.
- Draft BAA we can sign (to review by your legal/procurement).
- Architecture diagram comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs VPC (showing data flows, ingress/egress, logging).
- Ballpark timeline and costs for Dedicated & VPC options.

Proposed next steps / owners:
- Redwood: I will share SOC2 snapshot + draft BAA + arch diagram (attachments) by EOD tomorrow (Jonas).
- CarePoint: Liam — please confirm who from your security/network team we should loop in (name + email) and any specific audit report formats required.
- Marissa (cc) — can you prep estimated Dedicated capacity pricing and a short note on provisioning steps?
- Aditya (cc) — will be the main CSM for pilot and procurement touchpoint.

If Hosted is acceptable for an initial pilot, we can get a sandbox key out in 48 hours. If you need Dedicated/VPC from day one, we'll prioritize the architecture/design call next week and loop in engineering.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-snapshot-2025.pdf (will attach), redwood-baa-draft.docx (will attach), arch-diagram-hosted-dedicated-vpc.png (will attach)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@carepointhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Dr. Emma Willis <emma.willis@carepointhealth.com>
Cc: Sarah Zhang <sarah.zhang@carepointhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — deployment options & compliance asks

Thanks Jonas — and thanks Emma. A couple clarifying questions from our security team (Sarah added):

1) For SOC 2, can you confirm whether logs for inference requests are included in the coverage (request/response metadata, not full PHI)? We need to know retention windows and whether you can redact content on request.
2) For Dedicated capacity, do we get tenant-level audit logs and a dedicated logging endpoint? Our auditors will want exportable logs for quarterly reviews.
3) On BAA: we typically include clauses requiring data return/delete on contract termination and specific subcontractor disclosures. Can the BAA draft include those sections?

Rough timeline: we intend to present options to the procurement committee on June 15. If you can get the SOC2 snapshot and BAA draft early next week that would be ideal.

–Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement, CarePoint Health
liam@carepointhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call recap — deployment options & compliance asks (internal)

Looping internal notes here so we capture pricing/provisioning:

- SOC2 snapshot: we can share the 2025 Type II attestation + list of in-scope services (pdf). Limit PII in the sample report; redact org-level identifiers if needed.
- BAA: use our standard template but add explicit data return/delete and subcontractor list clause; legal can fast-track a one-off change if CarePoint signs SOW.
- Dedicated pricing: baseline monthly committed capacity (8 gpus) estimate = $38k/mo. 1-month ramp buffer and optional burst credits. If they need VPC network peering, add one-time setup $5k + networking hours.
- Provisioning: 3-week timeline after PO (week 1: infra allocation, week 2: model deploy & config, week 3: validation + customer review). VPC/on-prem: add 2–4 weeks depending on their network approvals.

Action items for us: I will prepare a short pricing spreadsheet and a provisioning checklist by tomorrow morning. Aditya — please get initial onboarding doc ready for Hosted sandbox if they want to pilot.

-Marissa
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Emma Willis <emma.willis@carepointhealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@carepointhealth.com>, Sarah Zhang <sarah.zhang@carepointhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — deployment options & compliance asks

Hi Emma / Liam / Sarah,

Per today's internal sync I've attached the items we discussed: SOC2 snapshot (high-level), draft BAA (editable), and an architecture diagram comparing Hosted / Dedicated / VPC with callouts for PHI flows and logging. Key notes below:

- Logs & retention: We include request metadata in our standard logging. Content-level PHI is not included in SOC2 artifacts by default; we can implement redaction/configurable retention for production for Dedicated or VPC customers on request. See arch diagram for where logs are stored and how they map to tenant IDs.
- Dedicated logging: Tenant-level audit logs and a dedicated logging endpoint are available for Dedicated customers; exportable in common formats (JSON/CSV). We'll include this detail in the pricing spreadsheet.
- BAA: draft includes data return/delete and subcontractor disclosure sections; flagged two customer-specific edits for legal to review.

Next steps / timeline proposed:
- Redwood to share final pricing spreadsheet and provisioning checklist: by Thu 2026-06-04 EOD (Marissa).
- CarePoint to confirm security/network POC: please share contact details by Fri 2026-06-05 (Liam).
- If you want to pilot on Hosted first, we can issue sandbox credentials within 48 hours on request; else we schedule an architecture call (30–45m) to scope Dedicated/VPC next week.

Let me know if you'd prefer the architecture call early next week — I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
